title: Where do you land?
subtitle: Wardley maps, shown before they are named, and the three centres of gravity: explorer, villager, town planner. 14 panels.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 18 October 2026, from Dinis's memo on Wardley maps
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is Dinis's words from the article 'Where do you land?', word for word; the build checks it. The map of Zara's first job is the storyboard's illustration, not Dinis's.

scenes.title: Where do you land?
scenes.subtitle: Maps first, names later; then the three kinds of people who build things.
scenes.note: The badges by the names are the three centres of gravity: compass, house, grid. Black and white, because the book will be.

scenes.caption: The explorer

cast.says: It works! Right, that's boring now. Next.
Failure is just an experiment, something you learn from.

scenes.caption: The villager

cast.says: Does it make my team's day easier? Then ship it.
The first version just has to work. The second version has to be designed.
